entries.test: Contemporaneous benchmark results comparing Gemini 3 with other available models would show whether it led on most measures.
entries.note: The comparison is anchored to the publication date.

entries.test: Timestamped public reports would show whether Gemini 3 errors appeared within hours of Google's announcement.
entries.note: The source anchors the timing to the announcement; the proposition substitutes release.

entries.test: Contemporaneous benchmark rankings and public evaluations of Gemini 3's general capabilities and limitations would test its benchmark leadership and claimed lack of AGI capabilities.
entries.note: “Great” is evaluative, but the sentence also makes substantive capability claims.

entries.test: Reproducible public evaluations of Gemini 3 and earlier LLMs would show whether hallucinations and reliability failures persist.
Public visual and physical reasoning evaluations would show whether Gemini 3 regularly fails tasks requiring those capabilities.
entries.note: “A mess” has a plain capability reading in this context.

entries.test: Public scaling studies and capability evaluations across successive LLM generations would show whether increased scale produces progress toward general intelligence.
entries.note: The present-tense claim concerns the observed scaling trajectory; it does not explicitly say scaling can never produce AGI.

entries.test: Historical and contemporaneous independent comparisons of OpenAI and Google models would show whether OpenAI's former capability advantage had disappeared by publication.
Gemini 3's published methods and comparative benchmark results would establish whether Google achieved superior results using only its TPUs without Nvidia GPUs.

Following commercial TPU availability at scale and competitive prices, public accelerator market shares, competing providers' price cuts, and compute pricing and substitutability would test the predicted outcomes.
entries.note: Making TPUs commercially available can include cloud access; selling TPUs narrows the stated condition. No deadline is supplied.
